name: Google Flights
description: Live flight fare search via Google Flights' internal API.
long_description:
Search real Google Flights fares from any agent or workflow. Port of the `fli` Python library (https://github.com/punitarani/fli) — talks directly to Google's `GetShoppingResults` endpoint, no HTML scraping or browser automation. Exposes `kernel_google_flights_search`, `kernel_google_flights_cheapest`, and `kernel_google_flights_recent`. Pairs with the bundled Flights Concierge agent that turns natural-language travel briefs into bookable options.

Disclaimer: this hits an undocumented endpoint with no SLA. Use sparingly and respect Google's terms of service.
author: Kernl
